{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove them
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Now, parse revenue: remove commas and cast to float
# Even though only 6 had commas, and they're gone, check if any remain
has_commas = df_clean['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Rows with commas in revenue after removal: {has_commas.sum()}")

# If any remain, strip them and cast
if has_commas.sum() > 0:
    df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].astype(float)

# Verify
print(f"First 5 revenue values after parsing:")
print(df_clean['revenue'].head(5))"}
